title: NEXSOLVE Temporal Network World Model Design

state.packet_features: the verified subset of the packet feature specification
excluded_inputs: raw timestamp as an unrestricted identifier
state.normalization: training-period-only transformations; robust/log transforms for heavy-tailed counts, with missingness indicators

transition_model.context: a fixed-length history of observed states and optional elapsed-time encoding
transition_model.target: next contiguous 60-second state; skip gaps or mark them explicitly rather than pretending continuity
transition_model.baseline: Logistic Regression comparison on leakage-controlled state features, trained chronologically; this phase does not run it
transition_model.future_model: probabilistic transition model whose output includes state distribution and predictive uncertainty

rollout.horizon: five contiguous 60-second steps, up to five minutes
procedure: start from states available through prediction time
feed the predicted distribution or sampled state into the next transition
aggregate attack-state and stage probabilities across rollouts
rollout.stage_probability: contextual hypothesis probability from a separately calibrated stage scorer; never ground truth without stage labels
rollout.uncertainty: ensemble or Monte Carlo rollout dispersion plus calibrated predictive intervals where supported
abstention: no verified packet coverage for a required feature
evaluation: macro-F1 and balanced accuracy for state
Brier/ log loss and calibration error for probabilities

progression_and_mitre.method: map observed packet/flow patterns to candidate ATT&CK techniques using documented contextual evidence and a calibrated multi-label scorer
progression_and_mitre.constraint: dataset attack labels are not stage labels; inferred stage outputs must be marked contextual, uncertain, and non-ground-truth
progression_and_mitre.evidence: retain source window, features, rule/model rationale, confidence, and abstention reason

leakage_controls: remove raw IPs or encode only training-fitted grouped representations
exclude fixed attack-time and scenario identifiers
exclude labels and attack categories from S_t
construct deltas using past windows only
fit preprocessing on training period only
split by chronological time and scenario/episode where possible
deduplicate overlapping flow/packet observations before splitting
never join future ground truth into historical features
